Incident notes supporting AZ-B as advertised writer, place on replica, confirmation OPEN, dual captures, writable standby lease; asks not to rebuild schema or rename checkout URLs.

Solver-visible evidence for current-state claims: az-a still writable, replica INSERT, sticky miss on django_session, dual captures for att-inc-20001/20007/20012, fence copied writable to standby, /readyz equated to /healthz.
Public knobs sticky_seconds=5, max_lag_lsn=25, incident_min_order_id=19980 referenced by runbook and used dynamically in lag/status assertions.

28 F2P + 6 P2P covering writer-only mutations and standby non-growth, sticky pins outside django_session, watermark seq_gap, sync_standby without writable lease, cutover epoch/demote, capture uniqueness and wal_lsn refuse, /healthz vs /readyz gates, dump schema and accepting conjunction including heal-true, reconnect pin/epoch, blank attempt, and route/schema/runbook path preservation.
Classification-only map (F2P/P2P labels and requirement families); used only to confirm ownership labels, not as coverage authority.
PASS requires complete forward/reverse matrices, instruction/docs walks, F2P/P2P and output-interface walks, second omission sweep, and empty BLOCKING_FINDING_IDS.
